LanguageData.MM_GuardianAutoCombatDesc: Pursue visible enemies, seek cover and fight near the edge of the 25-cell range. Shield support takes priority when enabled. Manual orders take priority over both.
LanguageData.MM_GuardianAutoRestoreDesc: Automatically restore allied shields within 25 cells at 25 points/s, spending 1 stored light per point and keeping a 10% energy reserve. Cannot restore its own shield or end recovery delays caused by shield breaks or EMP. With automatic combat off, only works while drafted.
LanguageData.MM_GuardianRestoreDesc: Approach an allied unit or turret and restore its shield within 25 cells. Restores 25 points/s for 1 stored light per point, keeping a 10% energy reserve. Stops when the shield is full or usable energy runs out. Cannot attack while restoring.
LanguageData.MM_GuardianNotReady: The Guardian is uncontrolled, unable to act or short of usable light.
